comments.author: home
comments.text:
Completed implementation of all Omarchy visual themes for Markus:
- Supported all 22 Omarchy visual themes: catppuccin, catppuccin-latte, ethereal, everforest, flexoki-light, gruvbox, hackerman, kanagawa, last-horizon, lumon, lupine, matte-black, miasma, nord, osaka-jade, retro-82, ristretto, rose-pine, solitude, tokyo-night, vantablack, and white.
- Added standalone theme stylesheets to static/themes/ and bundled theme CSS custom properties in static/markus.css.
- Registered and validated themes in markusmd.themes.AVAILABLE_THEMES.
- Added comprehensive BDD feature tests in features/themes.feature and site asset verification in features/site.feature.
- Verified full test suite with behave (135 scenarios passing), ruff lint passing, and demo site build succeeding.
